releasePolicyNote: This public package is fail-closed: a route named by officialNetworkDefectByRouteId or geometryReviewByRouteId is withheld until its complete alignment is resolved. referenceValidatedGeometryByRouteId is the narrow exception for a redistributable candidate that was checked locally against an official reference-only GIS whose coordinates cannot be distributed. blockedRouteIds rejects the service itself. See geometry_for in build-north-america-rail-package.py.
